{{Top|leg}}
The '''impulse intake regulator''' was a component of an [[Afterburner/Legends|afterburner]]. Bypassing the the regulator increased the amount of power entering the afterburner, enhancing its speed in turn. However, it was dangerous to bypass the regulator, with a high chance of melting the afterburners.
